(rule! (let ((dummy 0))
  (define (row-run r start end color)
    (list r start end (+ 1 (- end start)) color
          (for/list ((c (in-range start (+ end 1)))) (list r c))))
  (define (run-line run) (first run))
  (define (run-start run) (second run))
  (define (run-end run) (third run))
  (define (row-runs grid)
    (apply append
      (for/list ((r (in-range (rows grid))))
        (let loop ((c 0) (acc (list)))
          (if (>= c (cols grid))
              (reverse acc)
              (let ((v (at grid r c)))
                (if (= v 0)
                    (loop (+ c 1) acc)
                    (let find-end ((cc c))
                      (if (and (< (+ cc 1) (cols grid))
                               (= (at grid r (+ cc 1)) v))
                          (find-end (+ cc 1))
                          (loop (+ cc 1) (cons (row-run r c cc v) acc)))))))))))
  (define capped
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((run (in-list (row-runs g))))
      (set-cell (set-cell out (run-line run) (run-start run) 1)
                (run-line run) (run-end run) 1)))
  (define cap-components
    (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 1)) (objects capped 0)))
  (define chosen
    (for/fold ((best (first cap-components)))
              ((obj (in-list (rest cap-components))))
      (if (> (length (obj-cells obj)) (length (obj-cells best))) obj best)))
  (paint-cells capped (obj-cells chosen) 8)))
